title: [fr] Pure functional simplicity
excerpt: [fr] A meditation on keeping architectures minimal and rejecting unnecessary runtime abstractions.
author: Elena Vance
imageAlt: [fr] Minimalist architectural perspective with crisp geometric shadows

body.text: [fr] Every line of code added to a project represents liability. When static generation satisfies every business requirement, introducing a complex runtime server is an architectural misstep.
[fr] By generating every permutation of language and route ahead of time, we achieve absolute predictability.
